title: Sparkly paintbrush
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='handle' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#d98a2b'/>
      <stop offset='0.5' stop-color='#f5b95a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#c2701c'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='ferrule' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#8a9bb0'/>
      <stop offset='0.5' stop-color='#cfdae8'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#73849a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- sparkling glow dots (behind) -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='24' r='6' fill='#fff36b' opacity='0.25'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='72' r='6' fill='#7bf3ff' opacity='0.25'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='26' r='5' fill='#ff9be8' opacity='0.25'/>

  <!-- handle -->
  <rect x='41' y='30' width='18' height='58' rx='9' fill='url(#handle)'/>
  <rect x='45' y='32' width='4' height='54' rx='2' fill='#ffe0a3' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- ferrule -->
  <rect x='38' y='22' width='24' height='12' rx='3' fill='url(#ferrule)'/>
  <rect x='38' y='27' width='24' height='2' fill='#5c6b80'/>
  <rect x='38' y='21' width='24' height='2' rx='1' fill='#eef3fa'/>

  <!-- bristles -->
  <path d='M38 22 C36 12, 40 6, 44 4 L50 4 C54 6, 64 12, 62 22 Z' fill='#ff4f6d'/>
  <path d='M44 22 C43 14, 46 8, 50 6 C54 8, 57 14, 56 22 Z' fill='#ff9aae'/>
  <path d='M50 22 C50 14, 50 9, 50 6' stroke='#ffd0d9' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>

  <!-- paint blob drips -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='30' r='3' fill='#ff4f6d'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='33' r='2.5' fill='#ff4f6d'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff36b'>
    <path d='M20 30 L22 36 L28 38 L22 40 L20 46 L18 40 L12 38 L18 36 Z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#7bf3ff'>
    <path d='M78 40 L80 45 L85 47 L80 49 L78 54 L76 49 L71 47 L76 45 Z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#ff9be8'>
    <path d='M70 14 L72 19 L77 21 L72 23 L70 28 L68 23 L63 21 L68 19 Z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#b6ff7b'>
    <path d='M24 66 L26 70 L30 72 L26 74 L24 78 L22 74 L18 72 L22 70 Z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#fff36b'>
    <path d='M78 82 L80 86 L84 88 L80 90 L78 94 L76 90 L72 88 L76 86 Z'/>
  </g>
  <circle cx='34' cy='48' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='58' r='2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='80' r='2' fill='#7bf3ff' opacity='0.9'/>
</svg>
